headline: Cape Verde Holds Presidential Election with Incumbent Neves Favored
summary: Voting opened across Cape Verde as incumbent President José Maria Neves sought a second term among six candidates. Observers expect election continuity for the stable West African island nation.
why: Cape Verde is recognized as one of West Africa's most stable democratic jurisdictions, attracting European tourism and maritime infrastructure investment.

impacts.name: Cape Verde
impacts.why: Orderly electoral processes support institutional stability and international sovereign lending conditions.
